paper.title: Layout Optimization of Offshore Wind Farm Considering Spatially Inhomogeneous Wave Loads

author_assets.paper_implementation: Python SciPy Multistart-SLSQP coupled to FLORIS 2.4 and a precomputed wave-load chart
author_assets.paper_linked_source_scope: FLORIS wake-model dependency only; the target optimizer, cases, and wave arrays are absent
author_assets.target_public_source_status: exact-title, DOI, author, GitHub, laboratory, and paper-link searches on 2026-07-31 located no target source
author_assets.native_data_status: Case-2 bathymetry, 75737-element mesh, NCEP wind array, MIKE21/SWAN setup, wave-load chart, layouts, and histories unavailable

open_replacement_dependency.name: NLopt 2.11.0
open_replacement_dependency.use: pure-C++ Kraft SLSQP replacement for the paper's SciPy SLSQP wrapper

missing_information: target Python source and exact SciPy/FLORIS environment
SLSQP finite-difference step, tolerances, maximum evaluations, and random states
native Case-2 NCEP wind-frequency and speed arrays
native Case-2 polygon coordinates, bathymetry, 75737-element mesh, and MIKE21/SWAN setup
native Case-1 and Case-2 wave-load chart samples
optimized coordinates, per-start histories, and repeat protocol
completion_decisions: Retain the paper's 16- and 20-turbine cases, NREL 5 MW dimensions, 2D spacing, 24 wind sectors, Gauss wake, RSS deficits, two-stage formulation, and four alpha0 values.
Use FLORIS-v2.4 NREL 5 MW CP/CT arrays and legacy-Gauss parameters from the cited public dependency.
Reconstruct Case 1 from the published mild-slope, dispersion, shoaling, Stokes, Morison, breaking-impact equations and figure-informed smooth breaker completion.
Digitize the plotted Case-2 polygon, wind rose, and spatial wave-risk topology deterministically because the native arrays are unavailable.
Retain the paper's precomputed wave-load-chart architecture using a 0.25 m Case-1 linear table and 25 m Case-2 bilinear table.

Use bound-aware central finite differences with 0.5 m step and one-sided completion at active bounds, 15 starts, relative x tolerance 1e-7, and 300 SLSQP evaluations per start as declared completions.
Use raw AEP and wave-load physical objectives; normalized AEP is used only for the paper's alpha0 inequality.
Retain a feasible incumbent between successively relaxed alpha0 stages and retain every start when SLSQP returns a worse or infeasible point.

roles: Case 1: 16 NREL 5 MW turbines in a 3 km by 3 km mild-slope farm
Case 2: 20 NREL 5 MW turbines in a polygonal complex-terrain farm

decision_and_constraints.decision: continuous x/y coordinate for every turbine
decision_and_constraints.stage2: minimize total extreme-wave load subject to AEP divided by Stage-1 AEP being at least alpha0

physics.wind: 24 directions; Case 1 has 8 m/s equal probability and Case 2 uses a deterministic digitization of Figure 10
physics.wake: FLORIS-v2.4-lineage Bastankhah Gaussian wake with root-sum-square deficit combination
physics.power: FLORIS-v2.4 NREL 5 MW CP curve with 5 MW rating
physics.case1_wave: published depth, dispersion, shoaling, Stokes/Morison, and breaking-impact equations plus declared smooth figure completion
physics.case2_wave: declared deterministic figure-informed polygonal spatial load topology
physics.wave_hpc: immutable precomputed chart followed by linear or bilinear interpolation

algorithm.finite_difference: 0.5 m bound-aware central difference with one-sided completion at an active bound
algorithm.incumbent_rule: retain the best feasible start and propagate the best coupled layout through relaxed alpha0 stages

physical_fes_ledger.unit: one complete boundary, spacing, 24-state Gaussian-wake AEP, and interpolated wave-load evaluation of one layout
physical_fes_ledger.finite_differences: each plus or minus perturbed complete layout is one physical FES
physical_fes_ledger.selection_solver_bookkeeping: does not consume physical wind-farm FES
physical_fes_ledger.runtime_ledger: reported per run because SLSQP convergence determines the actual physical FES

hpc_execution.theory: the 15 mathematically independent SLSQP starts are parallelized by one persistent worker team; the immutable wave chart removes repeated dispersion and Morison integration from every physical FES
hpc_execution.ordered_semantics: every start has a deterministic seed and writes a fixed result slot; best-start reduction is ordered, preserving one/all-worker identity
hpc_execution.h6_rule: same source, seed, 15 starts, solver limits, physical FES, and scientific hash with one versus 15 workers
hpc_execution.formal_resource_rule: two paper-case runs execute concurrently with half of Waffle's cores each, filling all 20 cores while retaining 15 starts per paper case
hpc_execution.timings: evaluator critical-path estimate, algorithm-only residual, and end-to-end wall time are reported separately

formal_outputs: Stage-1 AEP baseline and four coupled layouts
alpha0, realized alpha1, beta, feasibility, and complete coordinates
physical-FES ledger and SLSQP-start success counts
worker receipt, scientific hash, source commit, and executable hash

claim_boundary: academic flexible reconstruction of the target Multistart-SLSQP and both paper problem roles; not author source, SciPy trajectory, native NCEP/bathymetry/mesh/MIKE21/SWAN arrays, or exact numerical optimum replay
